name: Air Jordan 1 High OG Patent Bred
description: For the end-of-year festivities, Jordan Brand has decided to offer us the most beautiful gift: the return of the legendary Bred colorway of its iconic Air Jordan 1 High sneakers, this time with a brand new Patent treatment. The Air Jordan 1 High OG Patent Bred features a premium patent leather structure that recreates the legendary color block of the Chicago Bulls team. Its black upper and laces are elevated by red accents on the collar, heel, toebox, Swoosh, and outsole. A cursive embroidered "Family" word is also found on the inner lining of the middle part. Completing the design is a metallic red Jumpman Hang Tag, adding an elegant touch. This flashy new iteration of Nike's timeless model manages to stand out thanks to its shimmering coating, while still showcasing its retro heritage.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Travis Scott Neutral Olive
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive is the latest collaboration between rapper Travis Scott and Jordan Brand. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Travis Scott Neutral Olive features a base in olive green suede, accompanied by white leather accents. The panels showcase a reverse black Swoosh. For branding, the Wings logo is embroidered on the heel, and the Jumpman logo on the tongue features volt accents. The shoe is completed with a white midsole and olive green outsole.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Mid Coconut Milk
description: Jordan Brand expands its autumn lineup with a versatile cream-colored addition. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Coconut Milk features a leather base that effortlessly transitions between off-white and white hues. To add an interesting contrast, the sneaker also sports a black Swoosh that perfectly matches the outsole and branding. Released alongside the Air Jordan 1 Low Coconut Milk, this colorway is essential for those who appreciate simplicity and minimalism. It is a must-have for individuals seeking a sneaker that exudes understated elegance and timeless style. The creamy tones and sleek design of the Air Jordan 1 Mid Coconut Milk make it a versatile and sophisticated choice for any occasion.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Dark Chocolate
description: Indulge in rich style with the Jordan 1 Mid SE Dark Chocolate. This sneaker features a luxurious blend of dark chocolate brown and black leather, offering a sophisticated yet edgy look. The mid-top silhouette provides a classic Air Jordan vibe, while the cushioned midsole ensures all-day comfort. With subtle branding and premium materials, these sneakers are perfect for those who appreciate a refined touch in their footwear collection. Whether you're hitting the streets or stepping out for an evening, the Jordan 1 Mid SE Dark Chocolate adds a deliciously stylish flair to any outfit.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High Off-White Chicago “The Ten”
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High is the ultimate must-have silhouette for any sneaker enthusiast. Since 1985, its iconic design has remained unchanged and its popularity continues to grow. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Off-White Chicago "The Ten" is the result of a collaboration between the renowned streetwear brand Off-White and Jordan. Building upon the successful partnership between Nike and Virgil Abloh, this model is part of the highly sought-after "The Ten" collection. Conceptualized by the founder of Off-White, this pair pays homage to the Air Jordan 1 Retro High's timeless appeal, featuring a leather base in the iconic color scheme of red, white, and black. The design is heavily influenced by the vibrant city of Chicago, which holds special significance as Virgil Abloh's birthplace.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Low OG Neutral Grey (2021)
description: Following the success of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High 85 Neutral Grey, the Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Neutral Grey" returns. Originally debuting in 2015, the 2021 update features a white leather upper with light grey suede accents on the Swoosh and heel. The Wings logo and Nike Air branding add elegance, making this summer release a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Mid Wolf Grey Aluminum
description: The Jordan Brand is making a comeback with a new iteration that exudes elegance, reminiscent of the iconic Air Jordan 1 High Dior. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Wolf Grey features a smooth white leather base, accompanied by gray leather overlays on the eyelets, mudguard, and heel. A blue side Swoosh echoes the matching outsole. A white Jordan Wings logo and a gray Jumpman on the tongue complete the sleek design. Following in the same spirit as the Light Smoke Grey and Barely Rose editions, this Air Jordan 1 Mid in a restrained colorway can effortlessly complement any outfit.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Low SE Concord
description: For the beginning of this year, the creative teams of Jordan Brand have released a special version of their best-selling shoe, inspired by the iconic color scheme of the Air Jordan XI Concord. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Concord features a combination of smooth and patent leather in a black and white colorway. With subtle branding and a discrete black Jumpman logo, this low-top sneaker pays homage to its predecessor from 1995. Staying true to the original design, it is equipped with a white sole and a translucent outsole. This release is a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts, offering a stylish and timeless look that captures the essence of the Air Jordan legacy. Get ready to elevate your sneaker game with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Concord.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High Off-White NRG
description: Virgil Abloh and Nike continue their collaboration with a new Air Jordan 1, first seen at Paris Fashion Week. This refined colorway features subtle elegance, with blue stitches on the Swoosh and orange accents. Off-White branding and "AIR" on the sole add unique touches. Highly limited, this release is exclusive to Europe. Will you be among the lucky few to snag a pair?
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Retro High Dark Mocha
description: The Dark Mocha 1 was one of the most anticipated releases in 2020 due to its familiar colorblocking that referenced two of the greatest Jordan 1s of all-time, the Jordan 1 Travis Scott and the Jordan 1 Black Toe.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive
description: Closing chapter for "La Flame" and Jordan Brand. The Houston artist unveils his seventh and final iteration of Air Jordan 1. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive showcases a luxurious black premium suede base. Overlays of creamy white leather cover the upper and complement the laces. On the side panels, you'll find the striking olive green inverted swoosh that pays homage to the outsole. As for the branding, the Wings logo embroidered on the heel and the Nike Air on the tongue boast a vibrant red hue. The entire ensemble rests on a vintage-looking beige midsole. With a motosport-inspired insole, the new Air Jordan 1 Low comes with a special box and three additional pairs of laces!
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Low Quai 54 (2021)
description: Since 2002, Paris's Quai 54 basketball tournament has thrilled audiences with its vibrant atmosphere and standout basketball skills, featuring exclusive collections like the coveted Air Jordan 5 sneakers. The Air Jordan 1 Low Quai 54 (2021) showcases a white leather upper with black accents, geometric collar patterns, and a striking red outsole. Quai 54 is a pivotal event in French basketball, celebrating competition and camaraderie, while its collections highlight Air Jordan's heritage, offering fans a piece of basketball history.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Retro High Hyper Royal Smoke Grey
description: Jordan continues to delight fans of the iconic silhouette. Following the success of the "University Blue" version, the American brand unveils a second predominantly blue colorway. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Hyper Royal is composed of a smooth white leather base, adorned with blue suede overlays that add a touch of elegance to the pair. Subtle grey accents have been added to the Swoosh and ankle areas. The grey outsole complements the overall color scheme, while the white midsole stands out. The play of different materials gives a premium feel to the sneakers, and the pastel color-block design adds a trendy touch. This Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG is more than just highly anticipated for the upcoming sunny days.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Low SE Light Smoke Grey Gym Red
description: Nike and Jordan unveil a new variation of their iconic model. The neutral tones of this low-top shoe bring to mind its popular High version, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Light Smoke Grey Gym Red features a white leather upper with gray suede overlays on the eyelets, mudguard, and heel. Red accents on the Swoosh, collar, and Jumpman logo add a refined touch to the retro silhouette. Completing the design by Peter Moore is a white sole that matches the laces and tongue. With its harmonious color scheme and mixed materials, this Air Jordan 1 Low is a must-have for the season!
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe
description: The iconic silhouette, the Air Jordan 1, has made a comeback with a perfectly seasonal colorway. This Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe (2023) features a base made of pristine white leather. Attention is then drawn to the black leather panels found on the collar, Swoosh, eyelets, and mudguard. Meanwhile, the toebox, flaps, and heel are adorned with a vibrant university blue color.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Low SE Light Curry
description: Step up your sneaker game with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Light Curry, a vibrant addition to the iconic Air Jordan lineup. This stylish sneaker boasts a bold Light Curry colorway, crafted with a mix of premium leather and synthetic materials for a sleek and durable finish. The classic Air Jordan silhouette is enhanced with modern design elements, making it a versatile choice for both casual wear and street style. Whether you're a collector or a fashion enthusiast, the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Light Curry offers a fresh and dynamic look that's sure to turn heads.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cement
description: Through a new release called the Air Jordan 1 Low, Nike celebrates the 35th anniversary of the iconic Air Jordan 3. This Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cement showcases a luxurious base made of black nubuck, complemented by leather overlays adorned with the legendary elephant print. The vintage effect is further enhanced by an aged-looking sole, reminiscent of the original AJ3 released in 1988. This commemorative edition pays homage to the timeless design of the Air Jordan 3, incorporating its most renowned elements into the Air Jordan 1 Low silhouette. The black nubuck provides a sleek and modern foundation, while the leather overlays showcase exceptional craftsmanship and durability. The famed elephant print, known for its distinctive pattern and texture, adds a touch of uniqueness and visual intrigue to the design. Furthermore, the vintage-inspired aspect of the shoe is carefully achieved through the deliberate aging of the sole. This not only adds character to the sneaker but also evokes a sense of nostalgia and authenticity for fans of the original AJ3. Overall, the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cement captures the essence of the Air Jordan 3's legacy while offering a fresh take on the iconic design. It is a testament to the enduring appeal of the Air Jordan brand and a must-have for collectors and sneaker enthusiasts alike.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Mid Barely Grape
description: Trendy silhouette, the Air Jordan 1 Mid is making a comeback in a new variant with purplish undertones. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Barely Grape features a white leather base accompanied by overlays in rose and violet tones. The heel reinforcement and flaps are presented in a purple shade, while a pale pink adorns the mudguard and eyelets, and a very light pastel violet color dresses up the collar. To create contrast, the side Swoosh and branding are in black. This new iteration of the AJ1 Mid, however, will be exclusively available in smaller sizes.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Year of the Dragon (2024)
description: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Year of the Dragon" sneakers Jordan celebrates the Lunar New Year with this stylised iteration of the Air Jordan 1 Low SE sneakers. They're fitted with scale-effect panels that nod to the Year of the Dragon and feature gold and red accents throughout – colours traditionally linked to wishes of good luck and prosperity.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Zion Williamson Voodoo
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Zion Williamson Voodoo is a colorful sneaker featuring a blend of moon fossil, oil green, flax, muslin fauna, and sesame hues. The shoe has a brown suede toe box and beige suede quarter panels. It also includes rough overlays in fossil, pale brown, and oil green. The lateral heel of the sneaker features a voodoo doll stitching, while images of Zion and voodoo are located beneath the heel tabs.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme Baroque Brown
description: For its fourth variation distinguished by Supreme, the iconic Air Force 1 Low will be adorned with a rich brown hue. The Air Force 1 Low Supreme Baroque Brown features a brown leather upper, accompanied by a tonal gum sole and round laces in the same color. Nike branding on the sole, heel tab, and tongue complete this magnificent silhouette, while the Supreme box logo at the back concludes the collaboration.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Black Supreme
description: After many weeks of anticipation and various teases, Nike and Supreme have finally unveiled a new collaboration on the iconic Air Force 1 sneakers. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Black Supreme features a simplistic design, with the entire upper covered in sleek black leather. Matching elements such as the laces, sole, and tonal swoosh add to the overall aesthetic. The finishing touch is the bold red Supreme box logo on the back of the sole, adding a subtle yet striking detail. This timeless and understated reinterpretation pays homage to one of the greatest sneaker classics. In fact, the Air Force 1 ranked second among the most purchased sneakers in the United States in 2019.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Tiffany & Co. 1837
description: Renowned jeweler based in New York, Tiffany Co., is collaborating with Nike on a special edition of the iconic Air Force 1. The Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Tiffany And Co. showcases a premium black leather base with an exquisite finish. The panels feature a Tiffany blue suede swoosh, reminiscent of the details on the outsole and the box. To top it off, a sterling silver 925 piece enhances the heel of this iconic low-top sneaker. Carefully crafted, this new silhouette embodies American elegance and seamlessly bridges the worlds of luxury and streetwear.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Nike Air Force 1 Low ’07 White
description: Undoubtedly, one of Nike's most iconic silhouettes is the Air Force 1. Created by Bruce Kilgore in 1982, this shoe, equipped with revolutionary Nike AIR technology, is continuously being reissued in a variety of colors each season. The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Triple White features a monochromatic upper made of premium full-grain leather. Every detail, including the laces, swoosh, and sole, perfectly matches the pristine white color scheme. The cushioned midsole and ankle reinforcement ensure unbeatable comfort, while the iconic metallic deubré proudly displays the inscription "AF-1" to complete the design. Undoubtedly, the Air Force 1 Low '07 is a must-have in any sneaker collection due to its exceptional versatility. This shoe effortlessly complements both casual and stylish outfits, making it the perfect choice for any occasion.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023)
description: A thunderous shockwave is taking the sneaker world by storm! After the releases in 2006 and 2012, the legendary Thunder is finally making its long-awaited comeback, bringing immense joy to sneaker enthusiasts. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023) showcases a sleek black nubuck base that elegantly covers the entire upper. Its distinctive feature lies in the vibrant yellow accents that adorn the sole, eyelets, and lining. As for branding, the iconic Jumpman logo is boldly displayed in white on both the tongue and heel. This exquisite reissue of the Air Jordan 4 is truly a holy grail for collectors, serving as the main source of inspiration for the much-anticipated Lightning and Red Thunder editions. Prepare to be captivated by the spellbinding allure of the Air Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023). Experience the harmonious fusion of timeless design and unparalleled craftsmanship, as this sneaker pays homage to its predecessors while paving the way for future mesmerizing iterations.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Mid Grey Green
description: The iconic brand with the Jumpman logo unveils a highly anticipated new release, the Air Jordan 1 Mid. This latest iteration, known as the Air Jordan 1 Mid Grey Green, is set to become one of the most coveted releases of the season. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Grey Green features a clean white leather base, complemented by gray overlays on the eyelets, heel, and mudguard. Adding a pop of color, there are several hints of green on the Swoosh, Jordan Wings logo, and outsole, creating a visually stunning contrast. With the goal of making the Mid version their biggest success of 2021, Jordan Brand has opted for a seasonal colorway this time around. This decision is sure to attract sneaker enthusiasts and collectors alike, as they eagerly anticipate the release of this stylish and trend-setting
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 Low SE WRMK Sashiko Denim
description: For the SNKRS Day, Nike will pay tribute to Japanese craftsmanship through a unique Air Jordan 1 Low. This Air Jordan 1 Low SE WRMK Sashiko Denim features a white canvas base, accompanied by denim overlays with frayed finishes. A black grained leather Swoosh adds contrast to the overall design and matches the outsole and stitching on the tongue, while the yellowed sole gives a worn-out effect to this unique silhouette.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 4 Retro Frozen Moments
description: In this late summer of 2023, the iconic Air Jordan 4 is set to receive a new variation, paying tribute to the remarkable feats of Michael Jordan. Introducing the Air Jordan 4 Retro Frozen Moments, a masterpiece crafted with meticulous attention to detail. The sneaker showcases a pristine white leather base, adorned with a resplendent layer of luxurious gray suede. A harmonious fusion that exudes sophistication and style. Adding a touch of elegance, the chrome flaps gracefully complement the eyelets, all seamlessly highlighted by the black accent piece above, where the classic TPU net proudly reigns. This exceptional silhouette derives its moniker from the mesmerizing skill of MJ, who, during his airborne journeys to the hoop, seemed capable of freezing time, leaving spectators awe-inspired at his prowess on the court.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 4 Red Cement
description: Very popular silhouette in recent months, the Air Jordan 4 is making a comeback in a new colorway. This Air Jordan 4 Red Cement features a white leather base, complemented by red speckles on the flaps, heel tab, tongue, and midsole. The whole look is completed with touches of black on the eyelets, lining, and outsole. A new variation of the AJ4, this silhouette is directly inspired by the legendary White Cement released in 1989.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.

name: Air Jordan 1 High OG Atmosphere (Bubble Gum)
description: Presented within the Jordan Brand Holiday 2021 collection, this new version of the iconic 1985 model draws inspiration from the chewing gum chewed by Michael Jordan during his games. The Air Jordan 1 High OG Atmosphere (Bubble Gum) showcases a white leather upper with obsidian blue accents on the eyelets, mudguard, and swoosh. The collar of the silhouette, as well as the heel and toe box, are adorned with a light pink patent leather in bubble gum tones. The entire shoe rests on a white sole embellished with a pink outsole hiding a crushed piece of gum as a reference to the GOAT's favorite treat. Using the color block of theBred Toe , this unique iteration stands out with its fresh and shiny color scheme, reminiscent of the Air Jordan 1 High OG Patent Bred. Overall, this Air Jordan 1 High OG Atmosphere (Bubble Gum) pays homage to Michael Jordan's famous gum-chewing habit during his basketball games. The white and blue leather upper, paired with the light pink patent leather accents, creates a vibrant and playful look. The hidden gum on the outsole adds a unique touch and connects directly to Jordan's personal preference for this sweet treat. With its fresh color scheme and iconic design, this iteration stands out among the Jordan Brand's Holiday 2021 collection.
materials: Premium leather and engineered mesh upper, foam cushioning, rubber outsole.
